_comment: Default bindings for the Dreamcast controller this package declares. The frontend ships
no bindings of its own - a package that declares a controller says how it is played by
default, and the user's own bindings always win. The face-button layout follows the
machine's: A and B are the lower pair, X and Y above them. The triggers are ANALOG, so
they are bound as axes rather than as buttons, which is what lets a game read how far

Dreamcast Controller.Up: Up, J1 POV1U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
Dreamcast Controller.Down: Down, J1 POV1D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
Dreamcast Controller.Left: Left, J1 POV1L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
Dreamcast Controller.Right: Right, J1 POV1R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight
